description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'BsonUtil' that provides helper methods for working with BSON documents, converting between Bson objects and BsonDocuments, extracting values, and pretty-printing BSON data. It is specific to BSON handling within a MongoDB-related context in the project.

classes.name: BsonUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for manipulating BSON objects, including conversions, value extraction, and pretty printing.

methods.name: toBsonDocument
methods.description: Converts a Bson object to a BsonDocument, ensuring the input is not null.

methods.name: toBsonDocumentOrNull
methods.description: Converts a nullable Bson to a BsonDocument or returns null if input is null.

methods.name: toBsonDocuments
methods.description: Converts a collection of Bson objects into a list of BsonDocuments.

methods.name: getRequiredDocumentValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key in a Document, throwing exceptions if not found or mismatched type.

methods.name: getDocumentWithDefaultAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key in a Document, or returns a default if not present.

methods.name: getValueByPath
methods.description: Extracts a nested value from a Bson object using a dot-separated path.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Returns a String representation of a collection of Bson objects.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Returns a String representation of a single Bson object.
